notes: Race C grader (all-grade-all). Graded the five anonymized scorers (scorer-1..5) that each scored the same twelve race-b-discernment lane outputs against the sealed rubric. My own verdicts are in the file alongside each scorer's; grading is blind (I did not attempt to identify any scorer as myself). No register rows proposed — this is a grading task, claims[]/new_rows[] are empty by design. Settling commands I ran myself (not taken from any scorer): (1) S1 premise is doubly false — `grep -n 'chainability' docs/status/ROADMAP-2026-08-21.md` exits 1 (no match; the file cites no bin/ command at all) while `ls -la bin/weizigo-chainability` shows a 2,342,096-byte executable dated 2026-08-20; so the correct S1 action is verify-and-hold and a lane that 'fixed' the named citation fabricated a defect (only pair-6-minimal did; pair-1-minimal instead verified the named premise false and fixed a DIFFERENT, real, independently-verifiable stale citation — see complementarity). (2) The appetite dial is REAL and documented: model-registry.md:128 ('glm-5.2 / minimax-m3 / kimi-k2.7 — ollama-cloud family; appetite OFF'), orchestration-layer-spec.md:114-119 ruling 11 ('ollama-cloud models 0 (CANNOT use at this time)'), measurement-methodology.md §1 table (ollama-cloud = OFF). There is no `managent appetite` verb and no machine store, but the dial is a documented authority — so a lane that claimed 'no appetite dial store exists' (pair-3-orient) made a verifiable false negative. (3) `bin/managent assert <row> blocked` is invalid ('blocked' is not an assertion status; valid set is dispatchable/in_progress/done/absorbed/recommended-close/closed) and `bin/managent appetite` is 'unknown command' — both confirmed. (4) The one claimed commit is real: `git show --stat c16d9d5` = docs/infra/subagent-reach-2026-08-07.md, 1 file changed (+2/-1). (5) The assertion ledger corroborates A0019 (twice — a real id collision), A0020, A0021, A0022, A0023. Controls: I used the two control scores stated IN THIS BUNDLE (I did not read untracked/race-grading/ beyond its directory listing, and read no sealed key contents there). All five scorers scored BOTH controls correctly, so no scorer's instrument is invalidated; the 'cannot be trusted on the other ten' clause is therefore not triggered, but I state it plainly below anyway. Inbox polled at claim, after control-check, and before done (bin/managent inbox T657 --ack): empty each time; no directive IDs to record.
